title: Australia
description: Scenes from the road, beside the water, and among the plants and wildlife. Small encounters lead into streets lined with flowers, then out to the harbour as daylight fades.

FXT37231.jpg.title: The road ahead
FXT37231.jpg.caption: From the back seat, the road curves away beyond the windscreen. Another stretch of the journey begins.
FXT37231.jpg.alt: View from the back seat of a car, with two people in silhouette and a curving road visible through the windscreen.

FXT36887.jpg.title: Across the grass
FXT36887.jpg.caption: A dog runs across the grass beside the water, with its front paws lifted clear of the ground.
FXT36887.jpg.alt: A black-and-white dog runs across a grassy area beside water, with a wooded shore in the background.

FXT37752.jpg.title: Looking out
FXT37752.jpg.caption: A camera is raised above the white railings. The clear blue sky leaves space around the figure.
FXT37752.jpg.alt: A person holds a camera to their face at the top of a white-railed platform against a clear blue sky.

FXT37639.jpg.title: At the water's edge
FXT37639.jpg.caption: A shorebird crosses the wet sand. Its reflection follows beneath it.
FXT37639.jpg.alt: A small dark shorebird with a long reddish bill stands on wet sand beside a shallow strip of water and its reflection.

FXT37644.jpg.title: A small visitor
FXT37644.jpg.caption: A tiny insect pauses on the wooden table beside a phone. A small detail becomes the subject.
FXT37644.jpg.alt: A tiny insect on a sunlit wooden table beside a hand holding a phone, with a long shadow across the boards.

FXT37586.jpg.title: At the end of the jetty
FXT37586.jpg.caption: The jetty leads towards a low band of cloud. Soft light spreads across the water.
FXT37586.jpg.alt: A wooden jetty extends into calm water beneath a blue sky and a broad band of grey clouds near the horizon.

FXT37979.jpg.title: Yellow on the branch
FXT37979.jpg.caption: Small yellow flowers catch the light along a narrow branch.
FXT37979.jpg.alt: Small yellow flowers on thin, spiky branches against a dark, blurred background.

FXT38174.jpg.title: Purple buds
FXT38174.jpg.caption: Purple buds and open flowers follow the curve of the stems.
FXT38174.jpg.alt: Purple flower buds and pale purple flowers grow along slender stems against a blurred green background.

FXT38262.jpg.title: One red flower
FXT38262.jpg.caption: A single red flower stands among yellow blooms. The wider view brings the colours together.
FXT38262.jpg.alt: A large round red flower rises above green leaves in front of a dense background of small yellow flowers.

FXT38394.jpg.title: Resting on a hand
FXT38394.jpg.caption: A cicada rests on an open hand. Fine veins show through its transparent wings.
FXT38394.jpg.alt: A large cicada with an orange-and-black body and transparent veined wings rests on a person's open hand.

FXT38039.jpg.title: Wings at the railing
FXT38039.jpg.caption: A white bird opens its wings on the railing, with green trees and distant hills behind it.
FXT38039.jpg.alt: A white bird faces the camera with both wings raised while perched on a dark railing, with trees and hills behind.

FXT38486.jpg.title: At the corner
FXT38486.jpg.caption: Red flowers hang over a brick wall beside a one-way sign. The street turns out of view.
FXT38486.jpg.alt: A one-way arrow sign on a brick wall beneath red flowers, beside a quiet street and pavement.

FXT38475.jpg.title: Flowers above the street
FXT38475.jpg.caption: Late light reaches the red flowers above the street. Buildings appear through the gap beside them.
FXT38475.jpg.alt: A dense mass of red flowers fills the right side of the frame, with pale sky and buildings visible to the left.

FXT38506.jpg.title: A glimpse of the bridge
FXT38506.jpg.caption: The street slopes towards the water. Beyond the buildings and trees, part of the bridge comes into view.
FXT38506.jpg.alt: A sloping street between buildings and trees leads towards water, with a steel arch bridge visible in the distance.

FXT36827.jpg.title: An orange sky
FXT36827.jpg.caption: The low sun lights layers of cloud above dark rooftops.
FXT36827.jpg.alt: A low bright sun shines through layered orange clouds above the silhouettes of rooftops.

FXT38515.jpg.title: The last light by the water
FXT38515.jpg.caption: People stand along the waterfront as warm light reaches the horizon.
FXT38515.jpg.alt: People and railings appear in silhouette beside a harbour, with buildings and a tall amusement ride beneath a blue and orange evening sky.

FXT38593.jpg.title: The bridge at dusk
FXT38593.jpg.caption: The bridge crosses a darkening harbour beneath pink clouds. A wide view closes the journey.
FXT38593.jpg.alt: A large steel arch bridge spans a harbour beneath pink and purple evening clouds, with city buildings along the far shore.
